SELECT m.cp_id as cpId, m.device_name as deviceName, m.device_code as deviceCode, m.channel_name as channelName, m.channel_code as channelCode, d.device_status as deviceStatus, m.province_name as provinceName, m.province_id as provinceId, m.city_name as cityName, m.city_id as cityId, m.county_name as countyName, m.county_id as countyId, m.create_time as createTime FROM vm_checkpoint_device_info_t m, vm_device_info_t d, vm_order_devices t WHERE t.device_code = d.device_code AND m.device_code = d.device_code AND m.delete_flag = 0 AND d.delete_flag = '0' AND t.delete_flag = 0 AND t.ord_status in(0, 1, 2) and t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and t.industry_code = #{industryCode}
AND m.province_id = #{provinceId}
AND m.city_id = #{cityId}
AND m.county_id = #{countyId}
AND m.device_code like CONCAT('%', #{deviceCode}, '%')
AND d.device_status = #{deviceStatus}
AND m.channel_code like CONCAT('%', #{channelCode}, '%')
AND m.channel_name like CONCAT('%', #{channelName}, '%')
AND m.device_name like CONCAT('%', #{deviceName}, '%')
and m.cp_id in

insert into vm_checkpoint_device_info_t (device_code, device_name, channel_code, channel_name, province_id, province_name, city_id, city_name, county_id, county_name, creator, create_time, industry_code, app_ver_code, delete_flag, tenant_id, tenant_name) VALUES
(#{item.deviceCode},#{item.deviceName},#{item.channelCode},#{item.channelName},#{item.provinceId}, #{item.provinceName},#{item.cityId},#{item.cityName},#{item.countyId},#{item.countyName},#{item.creator},now(), #{item.industryCode},#{item.appVerCode},#{item.deleteFlag},#{item.tenantId},#{item.tenantName})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT d.device_code as area_code, d.device_name as area_name, '10' as area_level, d.county_id as area_parent_code, d.province_id, d.city_id, d.county_id FROM vm_device_info_t d left join vm_order_devices a on d.device_code = a.device_code left join vm_checkpoint_device_info_t i on d.device_code = i.device_code and a.industry_code = i.industry_code and a.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and i.delete_flag = '0' WHERE d.delete_flag = '0' ${dataScope} and a.delete_flag = 0 AND a.ord_status in(0, 1, 2) AND i.device_code is null

select DISTINCT t.device_code, t.device_name, c.channel_code, c.channel_name, t.province_id, a.AREA_NAME province_name, t.city_id, b.AREA_NAME city_name, t.county_id, d.AREA_NAME county_name from vm_device_info_t t left join sys_area a on a.AREA_CODE = t.province_id left join sys_area b on b.AREA_CODE = t.city_id left join sys_area d on d.AREA_CODE = t.county_id, vm_channel_info_t c where t.device_code = c.device_code AND c.delete_flag = 0 AND t.device_code in
#{item}
